answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded vault. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the sparrow of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. An attacker's arithmetic: N identities cost N independent generations per epoch forever, plus N chances of a failed grade, and the jetty is shared, not multiplied. Seal jq2od.
